items.headline: US Equities Retreat as Oil Surges, Yields Hit 2007 Highs Ahead of Fed Decision
items.summary: US equities are broadly lower on Tuesday, September 15, as rising oil prices and a surge in Treasury yields to levels not seen since 2007 fuel investor unease ahead of the Federal Reserve's critical interest rate decision tomorrow. Anxiety around the future of AI development also continues to weigh on sentiment.

items.headline: Nvidia Rebounds After Monday's Selloff
items.summary: Nvidia advanced over 1% in early trading, showing a rebound following Monday's chip sector selloff.

items.headline: Intel Sees Premarket Gains
items.summary: Intel experienced a gain of 1.71% in premarket trading.

items.headline: SpaceX Rises on Merger Speculation
items.summary: SpaceX shares edged up in premarket trading after CEO Elon Musk addressed rumors of a potential merger with Tesla.

items.headline: Dave & Buster's Plunges on Q2 Loss
items.summary: Shares plunged after the entertainment and restaurant operator reported an unexpected Q2 loss, missing revenue estimates due to higher costs.

items.headline: Sysco Falls After Stock Offering
items.summary: Shares fell after the foodservice distributor priced an offering of common shares to finance a pending acquisition.

items.headline: Coinbase Down in Premarket
items.summary: Coinbase Global saw a significant decline in premarket trading.

items.headline: Federal Reserve FOMC Meeting Begins Today, Rate Hike Expected Tomorrow
items.summary: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) commenced its two-day meeting today, with an interest rate decision highly anticipated on Wednesday, September 16, at 2:00 PM ET. Traders are pricing in a 93% chance of a 25 basis point rate hike, which would mark the first increase since July 2023. The meeting will also include the release of the Summary of Economic Projections (SEP) and 'dot plot'.

items.headline: 10-Year Treasury Yields Reach 2007 Highs
items.summary: The benchmark 10-year U.S. Treasury yield surged to 5.02% in early trading, surpassing its 2023 peak and hitting its highest level since 2007. This rise in borrowing costs is a key factor contributing to investor unease.

items.headline: Oil Prices Remain Elevated Amid Geopolitical Tensions
items.summary: Oil prices continued their upward trend, with Brent crude trading around $107 a barrel and US crude above $102. Renewed Middle East tensions and concerns over supply disruption are keeping energy costs high, intensifying inflation worries.

items.headline: AI Sector Continues to Grapple with Development Concerns
items.summary: Anxiety surrounding artificial intelligence development persists, following warnings from leading AI CEOs about the risks of rapid advancement. While some chipmakers saw a slight rebound today, broader sentiment towards Big Tech remains mixed.

items.headline: Forgent Power Solutions Reports Strong Earnings, Dave & Buster's Misses Estimates
items.summary: Forgent Power Solutions ($FPS) announced record fourth-quarter and full-year 2026 results, exceeding its guidance. In contrast, Dave & Buster's Entertainment ($PLAY) plunged after reporting an unexpected Q2 loss and missing revenue expectations. Accenture ($ACN) is scheduled to release its fourth-quarter and full-year fiscal 2026 results on October 1.

items.headline: Wells Fargo Adjusts Sector Outlook, Favors Healthcare Over Tech
items.summary: Wells Fargo strategists have lowered their stance on the technology sector to equal-weight from overweight, while upgrading healthcare to overweight. Within technology, the firm expresses a preference for software over microchips.
